event.immune.es: ¡Tenés obra social! Este no te toca.
event.immune.en: You're covered! This one doesn't touch you.

event.popup.enjoy.en: Make the most of it while it lasts!

event.popup.wait.es: No hay con qué zafar: aguantá, que ya pasa.
event.popup.wait.en: No way out of this one: hang in there, it'll pass.

tutorial.tip.event_chip.es: Cada evento deja acá la cara de quien lo trajo. Tocala para ver qué cambia y cómo zafar.
tutorial.tip.event_chip.en: Every event leaves the face of whoever brought it here. Tap it to see what changes and how to get out of it.
